note: Family-owned for over 100 years, on Cranberry Lake near Marcellus; ~60-101 sites incl. 42 full-hookup and 18 elec/water; swimming beach, boat launch, boat/pontoon/kayak rentals, seasonal docks. Some sites directly on the water. Takes nightly transient alongside seasonal campers. --Claude
summary: Operator site: 2026 day rates electric only $45 / electric-water $49 / full hookup $50 (stored fees match; left); water and sewer confirmed (amperage not stated, derived 50 A left); showers, flush toilets, dump, laundry, store; season May 1-Oct 1 confirmed (now manual); reservations by phone. Google Maps: open, 4.3 stars / 217 reviews, phone matches. Seasonal share not published. Dropped season/amps/store from the note (fields hold them).
flags: Seasonal share not published: the operator sells seasons ($1,525-1,725 plus a $100 electric deposit, units under 25 years old) and monthly stays beside $45-50 day rates, but gives no count of seasonal vs nightly sites (RV Life lists 115 sites). Nightly sites are offered and reservable by phone, so test 4 cannot be measured from the pages.
Price gate: base electric-only $45 (full hookup $50) on the operator's 2026 rates page, at or under US$50; no gateway within 40 km; the family has not stayed.
